import json
from decimal import Decimal

data = json.load(open("orders.json"), parse_float=Decimal)
orders = data["orders"]

num_orders = len(orders)
total = sum(order["total"] for order in orders)

print(f"Number of orders: {num_orders}")
print(f"Total: £{total:.2f}")
